payload.blocks: Nothing; disk and worktree-list hygiene only.
payload.headline: Remove four superseded 2108 worktrees that confined heads cannot remove

parts.cause: The supervisor's confinement refuses `fgos worktree remove` (git-floor-probe-failed: read-only file system), and no unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session is reachable.

options.does: Owner runs: for s in p04r p04s p05r p07r; do fgos worktree remove /home/vantt/projects/forgent-worktrees/261122-2108-delete-dead-node-execution-closure-$s --delivered-to main; done
options.harm: None; --delivered-to main refuses anything not on main.
options.label: Run the removal yourself

parts.recommendation: Run the removal yourself; it is safe because the door refuses undelivered work.

scope.allows: Removing exactly these four worktrees through the delivered-to-main door.
scope.forbids: Any other worktree, branch deletion or forced removal.

parts.what: Four superseded worktrees of plan 261122-2108 remain: p04r, p04s, p05r, p07r under /home/vantt/projects/forgent-worktrees/. Their phases landed on main (0246095c2, a965fc3f1, 9388cae8f); the lead reports none holds unlanded work; p04s is dirty only with the landed phase 4 change.
